title: Opportunity of the Effect of Injectable Platelet Rich Fibrin (I -PRF) Mixed with Bone Graft on the Correlation Between Dental Implant Stability and Alveolar Ridge Width. A Clinical Comparative Study. Majeed, Sora & Thair, Abdul
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxresorb / maxresorb inject (biphasic CaP) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The addition of I-PRF with bone graft for augmentation of dehiscence and fenestration peri-implant defects with simultaneous implant placement results in 100% survival rate with statistical differences in implant secondary stability between study groups. However, the results were clinically irrelevant” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
